rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a wrapped package being sent or transported.

example.english: This parcel is being sent to you.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 baau1 gwo2 hai6 gei3 bei2 nei5 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a plot of land viewed as property that can be bought, sold, or developed.

example.english: This parcel of land is still for sale, so don't miss it.
example.traditional: 呢幅地皮仲未有人買，唔好錯過。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 dei6 pei4 zung6 mei6 jau5 jan4 maai5 m4 hou2 co3 gwo3

rows.note: Use this as the general choice for a part or portion of a whole, especially an abstract one.

example.english: This is only a parcel of the report.
example.traditional: 呢個只係報告嘅一部分。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 bou3 gou3 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6

rows.note: Use this when the portion is separately allocated, served, presented, or treated as one share.

example.english: The company says everyone will get a parcel of the bonus.
example.traditional: 公司話每人都有一份花紅。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 waa6 mui5 jan4 dou1 jau5 jat1 fan6 faa1 hung4
